title: determinant_enrichment_species_adjusted.tsv
description: Row schema for determinant_enrichment_species_adjusted.tsv. Tab-separated, UTF-8, LF, header row required.

pct_plasmid.description: Percentage of occurrences that are plasmid-borne.

crude_odds_ratio.description: Unadjusted plasmid-vs-chromosome odds ratio for the family against all other families.

crude_ci_lo.description: Lower bound of the crude 95 % interval.

crude_ci_hi.description: Upper bound of the crude 95 % interval.

species_adjusted_MH_or.description: Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio pooled across species strata; blank where not estimable.

species_adjusted_ci_lo.description: Lower bound of the MH 95 % interval.

species_adjusted_ci_hi.description: Upper bound of the MH 95 % interval.

n_species_strata.description: Species strata the family appears in.

within_species_all_same_direction.description: yes if every within-species estimate points the same way.

within_species_detail.description: Per-species n and OR, semicolon separated.

unique_plasmids_carrying.description: Distinct plasmid replicons carrying the family.

largest_mob_cluster_share_pct.description: Share of the family's plasmid occurrences in its largest MOB cluster; a clonality warning.

lineage_dominated_flag.description: yes if one lineage dominates; such families are reported flagged, never as independent findings.

crude_bh_q.description: Benjamini-Hochberg q-value over the crude p-values.

survives_species_adjustment.description: yes if the MH interval still excludes 1. 95 of 144 significant families do. 'not_estimable' where no stratum supports an estimate.
